description: This file defines health-related API endpoints using FastAPI for the Litellm proxy server. It includes health checks for services, models, database connectivity, shared status, and testing model connections. The included functions manage health check results, synchronize with a database, handle environment variable substitutions, and provide various endpoints for health status reporting and testing.

methods.name: dict _resolve_os_environ_variables(params: dict)
methods.description: Recursively resolves environment variable references in nested dicts and lists, substituting 'os.environ/VARIABLE' with actual secret values.

methods.name: dict _convert_health_check_to_dict(check)
methods.description: Converts a health check database record to a dictionary format for API responses.

methods.name: _check_prisma_client()
methods.description: Ensures the Prisma database client is initialized; raises an HTTPException if not.

methods.name: _save_health_check_to_db( prisma_client, model_name: str, healthy_endpoints: list, unhealthy_endpoints: list, start_time: float, user_id: Optional[str], model_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Saves individual health check result to the database with timing and error handling.

methods.name: dict _build_model_param_to_info_mapping(model_list: list)
methods.description: Builds a mapping from model parameters to model info (name and id) for aggregation purposes.

methods.name: dict _aggregate_health_check_results( model_param_to_info: dict, healthy_endpoints: list, unhealthy_endpoints: list, )
methods.description: Aggregates health check endpoint results per model, counting healthy and unhealthy instances and associating error messages.

methods.name: _save_health_check_results_if_changed( prisma_client, model_results: dict, latest_checks_map: dict, start_time: float, checked_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Conditionally saves health check results considering if the status has changed or sufficient time has elapsed since last save.

methods.name: _save_background_health_checks_to_db( prisma_client, model_list: list, healthy_endpoints: list, unhealthy_endpoints: list, start_time: float, checked_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Bulk saves background health check results, avoiding unnecessary database writes if state is unchanged.

methods.name: _perform_health_check_and_save( model_list, target_model, cli_model, details, prisma_client, start_time, user_id, model_id=None, )
methods.description: Performs health check and schedules saving results to database asynchronously.
